entries.title: A task's browser stays off your desktop when a page asks for a file
entries.body: When a website in a task's browser asks for a file, no window appears on your desktop any more. While you hold the browser, Infinitary opens its own file picker over its window. While the crewmate drives, it attaches a file from its own working copy. Printing and color pickers on a page no longer open a window either.
entries.noPicture: The fix keeps a window from appearing on the desktop; no view of the app changes, and the picker is the Mac's own standard one.
